content:
The expression factors as
\[
(a-b)(b-c)(a-c)=0.
\]
So at least two of \(a,b,c\) must be equal.

Total ordered triples: \(100^3\).

Triples with all distinct: \(100\cdot 99\cdot 98\).

Thus the desired count is
\[
100^3 - 100\cdot 99\cdot 98 = 1{,}000{,}000 - 970{,}200 = 29{,}800.
\]

\[
\boxed{29800}
\]
